_about: Welcome card and guided tours. The same file is in both apps: apps/web/src/tours/tours.json in the web repo and src/ui/tours/tours.json in the desktop repo. Keep the two identical; each app's tests check its copy. A step with "apps" shows only in those apps ("web", "desktop").

welcome.title: Welcome to Brick Layout Designer
welcome.text: Plan a LEGO layout for your next show, on your own or with your club.

layout.label: Start or open a layout
layout.text: Begin with an empty map, or open a file from this app or BlueBrick.

club.label: Join a club
club.text: Share layouts, venues and parts with the people you build with.

tour.label: Take the tour
tour.text: A few short steps that show you the main buttons.

steps.title: All your pieces live here
steps.text: Search by name, or pick a group like Train track. Drag a piece onto the map to place it.

steps.title: Sheets
steps.text: A layout is built on sheets, like see-through pages. Hide one to see what is under it.

steps.title: Place and move
steps.text: Click a piece to pick it, then drag it to move it. Drag a box around pieces to pick several.

steps.title: Bend flexible track
steps.text: Pick a flexible track, then drag the round handle at its free end to bend it.

steps.title: Saving and live sync
steps.text: This shows whether your changes are saved. In a shared layout, everyone's changes appear live.

steps.title: Share a picture
steps.text: Make a picture of your layout to post, print or send to your club.

steps.title: Help is always here
steps.text: Click a ? for a quick tip. The Help menu has the other tours and all help topics.

steps.title: Draw your venue
steps.text: Draw the walls first, then add doors, openings and things in the way, like pillars.

steps.title: Real sizes
steps.text: Type sizes in feet and inches or metres. The app works out the studs for you.

steps.title: Straight walls
steps.text: Snap keeps walls straight and corners square while you draw.

steps.title: Trace a floor plan
steps.text: Have a plan of the hall? Put the picture underneath and draw over it.

steps.title: Save the venue
steps.text: Save it, and start new layouts from it whenever you show there.

steps.title: Your server
steps.text: This shows whether you are connected to your club's server. Click it to add a server or sign in.

steps.title: Everything on your server
steps.text: Open from Server shows your layouts, venues, modules and parts, and your clubs', in one place.

steps.title: Mine and my clubs'
steps.text: Pick All, Mine or a club to see just those layouts, venues and parts.

steps.title: Save to
steps.text: When you make or publish a layout, Save to picks whether it is yours or your club's.

steps.title: Your club's page
steps.text: The club page shows who is in the club. Admins invite people from there.

steps.title: Joining a club
steps.text: A club admin sends you an invite link. Open it to join, and the club's things show up here.

steps.title: Look around
steps.text: Drag with one finger to move around. Pinch to zoom in and out.

steps.title: Make changes
steps.text: Tap Edit to change the layout, if you are allowed to. Tap a piece to pick it, then drag it to move it.

steps.title: Saved views
steps.text: Tap the layout's name to jump to a saved view, or to see the whole layout.

steps.title: Share a picture
steps.text: Make a picture of the layout to send to friends.

steps.title: Help is always here
steps.text: Tap ? for tips, and to take the other tours.
